output.body:
Dear {vendor} team,

We are writing to dispute the increased Monthly Service Fee applied under {agreement}. Our records show that the increase was applied from {applied_from}, before it was permitted under the agreement.

The agreement states: "{escalator_clause}" The agreement does not allow that increase to take effect until {first_application}, so the rate in effect before then should have remained {contract_monthly} per month.

Instead, invoice {invoices} billed {charged_monthly} per month. The difference is {overcharge_monthly} per month, for a total overcharge of {overcharged_to_date} to date.

Please issue a credit for {overcharged_to_date} to our account. Please also correct the monthly fee on future invoices so that it reflects the agreed rate until {first_application}, and send us a corrected invoice for the affected period.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. Please confirm once the credit and corrected billing have been processed.

Kind regards,
{sender}
